name: Gliding Menu
description: A bar of menus that share one panel, which glides and reshapes itself as you move from one menu to the next.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the nav element. Also accepts every other nav attribute.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of the top-level item.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content, usually a grid of GlidingMenuLink or GlidingMenuFeature with a fixed width. With children the item is a button with aria-expanded that opens the panel on hover, focus or press.

props.name: href
props.description: Without children, the item is a plain link to this address.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the item with aria-current for the section the page belongs to.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the list item. Also accepts every other li attribute.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the text.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the current page with aria-current and water-coloured text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other anchor attribute.

props.name: image
props.description: Thumbnail URL, shown at 96 by 64 pixels.

props.name: description
props.description: Up to two muted lines under the title.

props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other anchor attribute.
